answer: Cross-Epoch Task Diversity Threshold. Each agent identity must complete tasks spanning at least three unrelated task categories per epoch, tracked as a persistent profile. A new identity starts with zero history, so the system withholds high-value work until diversity accrues, like a reef building slowly. An attacker cloning an agent must run each clone through enough varied, low-pay tasks to build a walnut of genuine history before any clone earns trust. A mirror of the original's profile won't transfer, because category sequences are checked against timing and randomness,
